tasks.title: Frame stream between processes
tasks.solution: Bytes per second = W·H·(bytes per pixel)·fps. The module's example: 1280×720×3×30 = 82.9 MB/s, which is why heavy streams in C++ are put into one container with use_intra_process_comms instead of being passed between processes.

tasks.title: How much history a circular bag keeps
tasks.solution: The ring keeps n files, one of which is being written now, so n − 1 are complete. History = (n − 1)·b / r seconds; divide by 60. The disk space for the ring is n·b MB. Humble/Jazzy/Kilted have no --max-bag-files flag: a script of your own deletes old files.
